newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Lion Teck Chiang offers 32.52 mln shares in IPO.
newsitem.headline: Lion Teck Chiang offers 32.52 mln shares in IPO.

text.p: Lion Teck Chiang Ltd, a member of Malaysian conglomerate The Lion Group, said on Monday it was offering 32.52 million ordinary shares on the Stock Exchange of Singapore at Singapore $1.30 each.
The company said in a statement the share offer comprised 20.52 million public offer shares and 12 million restricted offer shares.
It said the offer price of Singapore $1.30 represented a historical price-earnings ratio (PE) of 16.6 times and a forecast PE ratio of 10.0 times.
The share offer was made up of 23.52 million vendor shares and nine million new shares.
The total share offer represented about 22.9 percent of the company's enlarged share capital of 142.07 million shares, the statement said.
Up to 3.25 million shares would be reserved for the group's employees, business associates and others who have contributed to the success of the company, the statement said.
Net proceeds of approximately S$10.9 million from the offer of nine million new shares would be used to repay debts incurred during restructuring, refinancing bank borrowings, and as working capital.
The offer will close on April 15 and trading is expected to begin on a when-ready basis on April 17.
Lion Teck Chiang is a property development and investment company. -- Singapore newsroom 65-8703080
